facts.headline: Peru's Water Emergency Reveals a Systemic Collapse from Summit to Soil
facts.summary: Peru’s water emergency reveals the collapse of a thousand-year system. Glaciers once fed rivers, fields, and cities. Now, water arrives unpredictably—if at all. This is not drought. It is systemic collapse, where mountain life unravels and the vertical logic of Andean civilization fails from summit to soil.
